english: You can rate your health worker and eye doctor after they care for you.
sw Kiswahili: Unaweza kumpa alama mhudumu wako wa afya na daktari wa macho baada ya kukuhudumia.

english: This report goes to the patient's eye specialist first. They check it, then send it to the patient.
sw Kiswahili: Ripoti hii inaenda kwanza kwa mtaalamu wa macho wa mgonjwa. Ataikagua, kisha aitume kwa mgonjwa.

english: Report sent to {name}. They'll check it and send it to the patient.
sw Kiswahili: Ripoti imetumwa kwa {name}. Ataikagua na kuituma kwa mgonjwa.

english: Check this report before it goes to the patient
sw Kiswahili: Kagua ripoti hii kabla haijamfikia mgonjwa
Ripoti kutoka kwa mhudumu wa afya
Imeandaliwa na {name}, mhudumu wa afya, kwa {patient}.

english: The patient only sees it after you send it.
sw Kiswahili: Mgonjwa ataiona tu baada ya wewe kuituma.

english: Reports that health workers made for your patients. Check each one, then send it to the patient. The patient doesn't see it before you send it.
sw Kiswahili: Ripoti ambazo wahudumu wa afya wameandaa kwa wagonjwa wako. Kagua kila moja, kisha uitume kwa mgonjwa. Mgonjwa haioni kabla hujaituma.

english: No reports from health workers yet.
sw Kiswahili: Hakuna ripoti kutoka kwa wahudumu wa afya bado.

english: This patient has no eye specialist yet. Send a referral first, and the report will go to that specialist.
sw Kiswahili: Mgonjwa huyu hana mtaalamu wa macho bado. Tuma rufaa kwanza, na ripoti itaenda kwa mtaalamu huyo.

english: Answers are in Kiswahili for now.
sw Kiswahili: Majibu yako kwa Kiswahili kwa sasa.

english: Words not translated yet into your language show in Kiswahili. Read aloud uses this phone's voices.
sw Kiswahili: Maneno ambayo bado hayajatafsiriwa kwa lugha yako yanaonyeshwa kwa Kiswahili. Kusoma kwa sauti kunatumia sauti za simu hii.

english: A community health worker from your area comes to your home to check your eyes.
sw Kiswahili: Mhudumu wa afya ya jamii wa eneo lako anakuja nyumbani kwako kupima macho yako.

english: Ask a health worker to come to your village to check the eyes of several people with diabetes on one day, such as at a church, school or chief's office.
sw Kiswahili: Omba mhudumu wa afya aje kijijini kwenu kupima macho ya watu kadhaa wenye kisukari siku moja, kwa mfano kanisani, shuleni au ofisi ya chifu.

english: A health worker will come to the village:
Your village visit request is waiting for a health worker in your area.
sw Kiswahili: Ombi lako la ziara ya kijiji linasubiri mhudumu wa afya wa eneo lako.
Kanisa, shule au ofisi ya chifu

english: How many people need an eye check?
sw Kiswahili: Ni watu wangapi wanahitaji kupimwa macho?

english: Anything the health worker should know?
sw Kiswahili: Kuna jambo mhudumu wa afya anapaswa kujua?

english: No internet? Dial the AfriEye USSD code on any phone and choose 2.
sw Kiswahili: Huna mtandao? Piga nambari ya USSD ya AfriEye kwenye simu yoyote na uchague 2.

english: Enter how many people need an eye check, from 2 to 200.
sw Kiswahili: Andika idadi ya watu wanaohitaji kupimwa macho, kuanzia 2 hadi 200.

english: A village visit is already requested.

sw Kiswahili: Bima ya afya kwa matibabu ya macho

english: Asked a health worker for help to apply for SHA
sw Kiswahili: Ameomba mhudumu wa afya amsaidie kujiandikisha na SHA

sw Kiswahili: Mhudumu wa afya anamsaidia kujiandikisha na SHA

english: Registered for SHA with a health worker's help
sw Kiswahili: Amesajiliwa na SHA kwa msaada wa mhudumu wa afya

english: Your request is waiting for a health worker in your area. They'll SMS you.
sw Kiswahili: Ombi lako linasubiri mhudumu wa afya wa eneo lako. Atakutumia SMS.

english: A health worker is helping you apply for SHA:
sw Kiswahili: Mhudumu wa afya anakusaidia kujiandikisha na SHA:

english: Keep your national ID card ready.
You are registered with SHA. Show your ID card at the hospital.
sw Kiswahili: Umesajiliwa na SHA. Onyesha kitambulisho chako hospitalini.

english: How is your eye care paid for?
sw Kiswahili: Matibabu yako ya macho yanalipiwa vipi?

english: This helps your health worker and eye doctor plan your care. SHA covers many eye and diabetes services at government and approved hospitals.
sw Kiswahili: Hii inamsaidia mhudumu wako wa afya na daktari wa macho kupanga matibabu yako. SHA inalipia huduma nyingi za macho na kisukari katika hospitali za serikali na zilizoidhinishwa.

english: SHA number, NGO or insurance name, optional
sw Kiswahili: Nambari ya SHA, jina la NGO au bima, si lazima

english: I have no cover. Ask a health worker to help me apply for SHA
sw Kiswahili: Sina bima. Omba mhudumu wa afya anisaidie kujiandikisha na SHA

english: You can also ask at your nearest health centre or Huduma Centre.
sw Kiswahili: Unaweza pia kuuliza katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu au Huduma Centre.

english: These patients have no health cover. Help them apply: dial *147# with them or use afyayangu.go.ke. They need their national ID number.
sw Kiswahili: Wagonjwa hawa hawana bima ya afya. Wasaidie kujiandikisha: piga *147# pamoja nao au tumia afyayangu.go.ke. Wanahitaji nambari ya kitambulisho.

english: The patient was sent an SMS.
Saved. The patient was told by SMS.
Choose how the patient's eye care is paid for.
sw Kiswahili: Chagua jinsi matibabu ya macho ya mgonjwa yanavyolipiwa.

english: Automatic: a Kenyan woman's voice if this device has one
sw Kiswahili: Kiotomatiki: sauti ya mwanamke Mkenya ikiwa kifaa hiki kinayo

english: This device has no Kenyan voice yet. On a laptop, open AfriEye in Microsoft Edge to get the Kenyan voices Asilia (English) and Zuri (Kiswahili). On Android, open Settings, then Text-to-speech, choose Speech Services by Google and install Kiswahili (Kenya).
sw Kiswahili: Kifaa hiki bado hakina sauti ya Kikenya. Kwenye kompyuta, fungua AfriEye kwa Microsoft Edge upate sauti za Kikenya Asilia (Kiingereza) na Zuri (Kiswahili). Kwenye Android, fungua Mipangilio, kisha Maandishi-kwa-sauti, chagua Speech Services by Google na upakue Kiswahili (Kenya).

english: These patients didn't go to their eye appointment. Visit or call them, find out why, and help them book again.
sw Kiswahili: Wagonjwa hawa hawakuenda kwenye miadi yao ya macho. Watembelee au uwapigie, ujue sababu, na uwasaidie kupanga tena.

english: People with diabetes need an eye check every year, or every 6 months if early changes were seen.
sw Kiswahili: Watu wenye kisukari wanahitaji kupimwa macho kila mwaka, au kila miezi 6 ikiwa mabadiliko ya awali yalionekana.

english: Too dark: turn on the adapter light
sw Kiswahili: Giza sana: washa taa ya adapta

english: Too bright: move away from the window
sw Kiswahili: Mwanga mwingi: sogea mbali na dirisha

english: Move closer: fill the circle with the eye
sw Kiswahili: Sogea karibu: jaza duara kwa jicho

english: Blurry: hold the adapter firmly against the eye
sw Kiswahili: Ukungu: shika adapta imara karibu na jicho

english: The camera couldn't be opened. Use Take photo instead.
sw Kiswahili: Kamera haikufunguka. Tumia Piga picha badala yake.

english: Mark each past appointment. A missed visit goes to the patient's health worker to follow up.
sw Kiswahili: Weka alama kwa kila miadi iliyopita. Miadi iliyokosekana inatumwa kwa mhudumu wa afya wa mgonjwa kufuatilia.

english: No past appointments in the last 4 months.
sw Kiswahili: Hakuna miadi iliyopita katika miezi 4 iliyopita.

Uwezo wa kuona baadaye, jicho la kushoto
Sukari ya damu na shinikizo la damu

english: Keeping blood sugar and blood pressure under control protects your eyes. Your health worker records readings at each visit, and you can add your own.
sw Kiswahili: Kudhibiti sukari na shinikizo la damu hulinda macho yako. Mhudumu wako wa afya hurekodi vipimo kila ziara, na unaweza kuongeza vyako.

english: Your eye check is overdue. Ask your health worker to visit you.
sw Kiswahili: Ukaguzi wako wa macho umechelewa. Mwombe mhudumu wa afya akutembelee.

english: Early changes were seen, so check again after 6 months.
sw Kiswahili: Mabadiliko ya awali yalionekana, kwa hivyo pima tena baada ya miezi 6.

english: People with diabetes need an eye check every year.
sw Kiswahili: Watu wenye kisukari wanahitaji kupimwa macho kila mwaka.

english: Send me a tip like this every week by SMS
sw Kiswahili: Nitumie ushauri kama huu kila wiki kwa SMS

english: You'll get a tip by SMS every week.
sw Kiswahili: Utapokea ushauri kwa SMS kila wiki.

english: Diabetic eye screening. Totals only: no patient names are shown here.
sw Kiswahili: Upimaji wa macho kwa wenye kisukari. Jumla tu: hakuna majina ya wagonjwa hapa.
Siku za wastani hadi ukaguzi wa mtaalamu

english: How well the AI agrees with the eye specialists
sw Kiswahili: Jinsi AI inavyokubaliana na wataalamu wa macho
Jibu 4 kati ya 5 kwa usahihi ili kufaulu.

english: Not yet. Read the lessons again and retry.
sw Kiswahili: Bado. Soma masomo tena na ujaribu tena.
Cheti chako cha mafunzo ya AfriEye

english: Marked as missed. The health worker will follow up.
sw Kiswahili: Imewekwa kama imekosekana. Mhudumu wa afya atafuatilia.

english: Treatment saved. The patient was told.
The {c} County health office gave this reason:
sw Kiswahili: Ofisi ya afya ya Kaunti ya {c} ilitoa sababu hii:

english: If this is a mistake, contact the county health office with your licence certificate. They can approve your account later.
sw Kiswahili: Ikiwa hili ni kosa, wasiliana na ofisi ya afya ya kaunti ukiwa na cheti chako cha leseni. Wanaweza kuidhinisha akaunti yako baadaye.

english: The {c} County health office checks your licence on the KMPDC or Clinical Officers Council register.
sw Kiswahili: Ofisi ya afya ya Kaunti ya {c} inakagua leseni yako kwenye sajili ya KMPDC au Baraza la Maafisa wa Kliniki.

english: The AfriEye system administrator checks your staff number with the county.
sw Kiswahili: Msimamizi wa mfumo wa AfriEye anakagua nambari yako ya mfanyakazi na kaunti.

english: Your CHW ID needs to be checked.
sw Kiswahili: Kitambulisho chako cha CHW kinahitaji kukaguliwa.

english: This stops people pretending to be health workers. You'll get an SMS when it's done. Until then you can't see patient records.
sw Kiswahili: Hii inazuia watu kujifanya wahudumu wa afya. Utapokea SMS ikikamilika. Hadi wakati huo huwezi kuona rekodi za wagonjwa.

english: Check that the name and licence number match the official register, and call the hospital if unsure.
sw Kiswahili: Hakikisha jina na nambari ya leseni vinalingana na sajili rasmi, na upigie hospitali ukiwa na shaka.

english: New eye clinicians at hospitals in your county wait here until you check their licence. This stops people pretending to be specialists.
sw Kiswahili: Matabibu wapya wa macho katika hospitali za kaunti yako wanasubiri hapa hadi ukague leseni zao. Hii inazuia watu kujifanya wataalamu.

english: Approved. The clinician was told by SMS.
Rejected. The person was told by SMS.
This is a shared demo account, so this setting is switched off. Register your own account to try it.
sw Kiswahili: Hii ni akaunti ya majaribio inayoshirikiwa, kwa hivyo mpangilio huu umezimwa. Jisajili akaunti yako ili ujaribu.
